label: Schopenhauer synthesized Buddhist Sunyata and cessation of desire with Western metaphysics
Śaṅkara contended that relational emptiness without an absolute positive ground (Brahman) fails to account for consciousness and epistemic certainty
Comparative thinkers identify strong structural homologies between Buddhist relational emptiness (Śūnyatā) and Derrida's différance (endless deferral of fixed identity)
